text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — elevated 5xx and timeouts in prod-west after rolling out release v3.8.4 (deploy-id: d-2026-11-03-88). p95 latency jumped to 2.1s, p99 to ~13s, 5xx rate ~1.9% over the last 5m. Alerting SLOs and paging oncall.

jess (oncall): ack, joining. any links to traces/graph?

nina (sre): Metrics here: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dashboards/ops/prod-west/latency?from=now-15m  — seeing a tall p99 spike around 4070012200. Error distribution is mostly gateway timeouts (504) and backend 502s.

omar (backend): saw a spike in connection pool errors in the API pods. stack traces show `connection reset by peer` from upstream model-proxy. Suspect connection pool sizing change from the new deploy.

maya (prod-eng): FYI the deploy toggled the torpedo-conn-pool flag (default was 200 -> now 50) in the rollout config. I pushed that change to reduce resource pressure during canary, maybe we clipped it too low.

liam (support): we already have two customer tickets referencing timeouts: TKT-39821 (GreenLeaf) and TKT-39822 (Evora). Both show requests failing intermittently for embeddings endpoint. Customer impact: GreenLeaf reported ~30% failed invocations for a 10-minute window.

jess (oncall): can we confirm it's the conn-pool change? nina, can you snapshot pod env/config for canary vs stable?

nina (sre): `kubectl -n prod get deploy api-service -o yaml | grep torpedo-conn-pool` shows `50` on the new replicaset, `200` on the previous. attaching recent logs snippet:

```
2026-11-03T12:03:10Z api-service-7f8c9 pod/0 ERROR upstream: connection reset by peer
2026-11-03T12:03:11Z api-service-7f8c9 pod/0 WARN pool depleted, wait queued
2026-11-03T12:03:12Z api-service-7f8c9 pod/0 ERROR request timeout 15s
```

deploy-bot: Automated safety check triggered: 5xx rate > 1% and p99 > 10s. Initiating rollback plan per policy (auto-rollback: disabled). Not performing rollback automatically — manual opt-in required.

maya (prod-eng): I'm going to roll back the torpedo-conn-pool override first (patch to 200) and monitor. If that doesn't clear quickly, we should roll the whole release back.

omar (backend): +1. patching now. Command: `kubectl -n prod set env deploy/api-service TORPEDO_CONN_POOL=200 --record`

jess (oncall): i'll watch telemetry. Please ping when the env is patched and pods cycle.

nina (sre): pods are restarting, new replicas coming up. watching readiness.

liam (support): Customer update draft: "We're investigating intermittent timeouts affecting embeddings calls in US-West; engineering is rolling back a configuration change and we'll follow up in 30m." Want me to send?

tara (product): yes please send — prioritize the GreenLeaf contact. Mark as high-severity customer-facing.

jess (oncall): telemetry looks improved for p95 but p99 still elevated. 5xx fell from 1.9% -> 0.9% after the env patch. Not fully recovered.

omar (backend): digging deeper — rollout included a new upstream proxy binary version that changed keepalive and connection reuse semantics. With pool=50 it amplified queueing. If p99 remains noisy, we should revert to previous deploy (v3.8.3).

maya (prod-eng): preparing rollback. Command I will run in 2m: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-service --to-revision=2 && kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/api-service`

jess (oncall): please include the deploy-id in the rollback command and notify when complete.

deploy-bot: Rollback queued by maya. Estimated impact: quick pod rotation; expectation: <3m for traffic shift.

maya (prod-eng): executed rollback at 4070012705. Output:

```
deployment.apps/api-service "api-service" rolled back to revision 2
waiting for rollout to finish: 1 of 4 updated replicas are available...
rollout complete
```

nina (sre): metrics show p99 dropping back toward baseline, 5xx now 0.2% and error traces are no longer showing the connection pool depletion logs.

liam (support): sent update to GreenLeaf and Evora with ETA and rollback confirmation. GreenLeaf replied: "Thanks — seeing improvements on our side, latency back to normal for most requests."

jess (oncall): handing off to night oncall (nina) in 15m. Summary for handoff: deploy v3.8.4 introduced conn-pool=50 + proxy v2.1.7, caused queueing -> p99/timeouts; we patched env -> partial fix; full rollback to v3.8.3 completed at 4070012705, metrics stable. Open action items: 1) revert the torpedo-conn-pool change in rollout templates, 2) run canary of proxy v2.1.7 with load-test simulating long-lived requests, 3) postmortem to triage deploy gating.

nina (sre): ack, will pick up. I'll create an incident doc and link postmortem template.

maya (prod-eng): creating rollout guard in CI: add verification that conn-pool env is >=100 for prod.

omar (backend): I'll instrument more detailed client-side socket metrics to catch early signs next time.

liam (support): closing customer-facing updates for now; will reopen if regression reappears.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) — status: recovered. Escalation debrief scheduled for 4070050000 (handoff + postmortem).

jess (oncall): thanks all. leaving final note: if anyone sees residual 504s from 4070012100-4070012900 window, tag the incident thread and include request IDs. :thumbsup:
